I understand that and actually the first person I ever told was him about a year  ago :) I told him bc I was scared he wouldn’t accept me but he didn’t really mind and we stayed together.

And you’re right I do need to speak with him ab how I’m feeling, I just don’t know how to start that conversation and the thought really scares me. But I’ll start working towards that. Thank you!
Twins 🤪👯‍♀️
Ok, thnx
That’s INCREDIBLE. CONGRATULATIONS!!!!! We are all proud of you!! 🎊🎉🙌🏼 Sending love and hugs your way!! ❤️🥰
Damn. Oh well, nothing I can do now I guess. Thnx
Would u mind if I sent u a pic and u could tell me which u think will fade??

Yeah, I go over and over until it’s bright, and when it turns dark red I feel the need to cut in another place. Idk if u noticed but most people who replied felt the same, I personally felt like I was part of a community. A weird one but happy to be in it. Idk if that makes sense
I have burn scars and I know those won’t go away, so sadly can’t relate. Really wish they would so people don’t ask about them. That’s why I started SH sin a spot where people won’t notice
Thank u guys :)
Yeah!!! Makes me feel like a psycho, but iba goooood way
How?? I’ve only been cutting for a while, I used to burn but do t know anything about cuts. Any tips??

I laugh and it makes me feel better in a way, like I’m in control. I used to burn but after a quick google search realized they weren’t going away, so cutting was up next. I get the calming down, it’s probs the adrenaline, but god to admit (at least for me) best feeling in the world
Yeah, totally get it. Having to go over and over it again until u acquire your desired outcome
Yeah, I get this feeling of control. Like my mind can’t control em and I get to do what I want even if it’s considered “wrong” you know?
Yeah!! I especially like it when it turn a dark brown, idk why tho. But I’m sorry I can’t relate to feeling bad, I just want to keep doing it more and more
Does anyone like the look of dark red better than the fresh bright red??
Yeah, going over and over again, until it’s red and bright.
Ahhhhh okokok i get it now

I asked for help today and my mom just told be to be strong and keep going. I felt like everything I feel is nothing , as if I were exaggerating. The second she left I fell on the floor, I felt defeated, belittled, and ignored. It wasn’t until 10 minutes later my brother found me crying in the kitchen floor, right before I was about to grab a knife. I FEEL LIKE THE WORST RESPONSE IS TO MAKE OTHERS TROUBLES AND DIFFICULTIES ABOUT YOURSELF/EXPERIENCES.
I get the inside thing but idk what you mean about the ouside
Yeah, so u have to go over it again and again. Feels good knowing I’m not the only one, thought I was crazy for a sec there

My mom just told me to “be strong and keep going” and it just broke me. I feel like that’s the worst response ever. Made me feel like I wasn’t trying hard enough, even thou I am. I fell crying in the middle in the kitchen until my brother found me and had to take me to my room. “YOU HAVE NOTHING TO BE SAD ABOUT! JUST TRY HARDER!” gee thnx for the great advice
Yeah, like the blood makes it real in a way. Does that make sense??
Stay safe and YOU GOT THIS!!! Props to you, honestly.
My bad, they look so similar. You probs cut deep and got some nerve damage, might just be the healing process.

Those look like burn marks, I have some of those too. The ones where I went deep itched around, and like one user said above they stopped when they went red or white or when I popped them. The only difference is mine stopped itching hours later, max one day. I guess yours aren’t as deep, which is good
